roles.title: Director Of Product, Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain

bullets: Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain systems, tied to company strategy and the priorities of Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding…
Build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers and analysts including hiring, career development, and clear accountability for outcomes.
Partner with senior Supply Chain, Finance, Care, Onboarding, and Technology leadership to translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
Work with upstream and downstream BTT teams and R&D to align roadmaps, manage cross-team dependencies, and agree on who owns data and integrations across systems.

Drive roadmap of features aimed at supporting Toast’s Enterprise full-service customers
Actively manage your teams’ backlogs through the creation, prioritization, and grooming of user stories in a fast paced agile environment
